name: John Lennon
description: John Lennon in the 1965 Beatles cartoon style, with a wide rounded jaw, long nose and blue suit.
character_notes: John Lennon 1965 Beatles cartoon. WIDE rounded U-shaped long lower jaw, LONG J-shaped thin nose with hooked end, sleepy almond eyes, black mop hair and square sideburns. Blue suit jacket and matching long blue trousers, blue collared shirt and narrow navy tie, black pointed shoes. Preserve original mature slender cartoon proportions. No guitar or new props. Flat cel-cartoon colors and crisp black outlines, exact source identity. Head pitch/yaw for looks with anchored frontal torso and feet.
